replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states server charges browser-sent final price; concrete price-tampering attack on Stripe charge."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design names discount code entry; brute-force harvesting of codes is a distinct attack from reuse."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Browser-side discount evaluation supported; reuse/stacking/expired-code abuse distinct from arbitrary price tampering."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design stores only browser-sent amount and Stripe charge; missing discount provenance blocks dispute resolution."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Checkout endpoint passes charges to Stripe; scripted flooding/card-testing is a distinct harm, specific to named flow."}]}
